note: Copied from WDFW's emergency rules RSS feed (the newest ~30 notices). Older rules that are still in effect may not be in the feed.

items.title: Skykomish River to remain closed to salmon fishing
items.locations: Skykomish River from the mouth to the railroad bridge at Big Eddy.
items.action: Closes all salmon fishing.

items.title: Copalis River, Joe Creek, and Moclips River closing to all fishing
items.action: Closes all fishing.

items.title: Upper Quinault River closing to all fishing
items.locations: Upper Quinault River from the mouth at the upper end of Lake Quinault to Olympic National Park Boundary.
items.action: Closes all fishing.

items.title: Salmon River closing to all fishing
items.locations: Salmon River, outside of Quinault Indian Reservation and Olympic National Park.
items.action: Closes all fishing.

items.title: Willapa Bay freshwater tributaries close to all recreational fishing
items.action: Closes all fishing.

items.title: Marine Area 2-1 (Willapa Bay) to close to all recreational fishing
items.locations: Marine Area 2-1 (Willapa Bay).
items.action: Closes all fishing.

items.title: Marine Area 2-2 (Grays Harbor) closing to all fishing
items.locations: Marine Area 2-2 (Grays Harbor) including Humptulips North Bay and East Grays Harbor but excluding the Ocean Shores and Westport boat basins.
items.action: Closes all fishing.

items.title: Grays Harbor tributary streams closing to all fishing
items.action: Closes all fishing.

items.title: Hatchery coho daily limit reduced in the Dungeness River
items.locations: Dungeness River from the mouth to the Gray Wolf River at Dungeness Forks Campground.
items.action: Reduces the salmon daily limit to two hatchery coho salmon.

items.title: Hoh and Quillayute watersheds closing to all fishing
items.action: Closes all fishing.

items.title: Cascade River to open seven days per week to fishing, and temporary closure implemented in a portion of the Skagit River
items.action: Opens a portion of the Cascade River to fishing seven days per week. Maintains previously announced bait prohibitions, single-point barbless hooks requirement for salmon on Cascade and Skagit rivers, and a reduced daily limit of two coho on the upper Skagit River. Updates temporary fishing closures scheduled for tribal fisheries on Skagit River.

items.title: Clearwater River to close to all fishing
items.locations: Clearwater River (Jefferson County) from the mouth upstream.
items.action: Closes all fishing on the Clearwater River.

items.title: Marine Area 9 (Admiralty Inlet), Marine Area 12 (Hood Canal) shellfish beaches update
items.action: Extends clam, mussel, and oyster harvest at Belfair State Park, opens clam, mussel and oyster harvest at Duckabush Tidelands and Triton Cove Tidelands, and extends oyster harvest at Point Whitney Tidelands and Point Whitney Lagoon; opens and modifies other previously announced changes to public shellfish beaches in marine areas 9 and 12.

items.title: Marine Area 8-1 (Deception Pass, Hope Island, and Skagit Bay) and Marine Area 8-2 (Ports Susan and Gardner) opening for late-season recreational crab fishing
items.locations: Marine Areas 8-1 and 8-2.
items.action: Opens winter crab seasons in Marine Area 8-1 (Deception Pass, Hope Island, and Skagit Bay) and Marine Area 8-2 (Ports Susan and Gardner) ; crabbing is allowed seven days a week Oct. 10–Dec. 31 in these areas.
items.species: Dungeness, red rock, and Tanner crab.

items.title: Stillaguamish River to close to all fishing Oct. 9
items.locations: Stillaguamish River from Marine Drive (south of Stanwood) upstream to the forks at the confluence of the North Fork and South Fork Stillaguamish rivers near Arlington.
items.action: Closes recreational fishing in the mainstem Stillaguamish River.

items.title: Quillayute River reopens to fishing with reduced retention limits and no bait
items.locations: Quillayute River (Clallam County), from Olympic National Park boundary upstream to confluence of Sol Duc and Bogachiel rivers.
items.action: Reopens fishing in the Quillayute River with reduced salmon retention limits and prohibits bait for all species.

items.title: Snohomish River to close to all fishing Oct. 3
items.locations: Snohomish River, from the mouth to the confluence of the Skykomish and Snoqualmie rivers.
items.action: Closes all fishing.

items.title: Some areas of Puget Sound reopening for late-season recreational crab fishing
items.locations: Marine Area 4 east of the Tatoosh-Bonilla line, Marine Area 5, Marine Area 6, Marine Area 7, Marine Area 9, and Marine Area 12 north of a line projected due east from Ayock Point.
items.action: Opens winter crab seasons in Marine areas 4 east of the Bonilla-Tatoosh line, 5, 6, 7 (North and South), 9, and 12 north of a line projected due east from Ayock Point; crabbing is allowed seven days a week Oct. 1–Dec. 31 in these areas.
items.species: Dungeness, red rock, and Tanner crab.

items.title: Mineral Lake fishing season extended through Oct. 31
items.locations: Mineral Lake (Lewis County).
items.action: Opens the Mineral Lake game fish season through Oct. 31 annually.

items.title: Icicle River to open for coho salmon retention
items.locations: Icicle River (Chelan County)
items.action: Opens the Icicle River to retention of coho salmon.

items.title: Errata (pamphlet corrections)
Lower Columbia River salmon and steelhead fishery update
items.action: Opens Chinook retention from Buoy 10 to the Highway 395 Bridge at Pasco and coho retention from the west end of Puget Island to the Highway 395 Bridge at Pasco.

items.title: Hanford Reach fall Chinook fishery update
items.action: Closes retention of wild (unmarked) adult Chinook in the Hanford Reach of the Columbia River beginning Sept. 23, 2026.

items.title: Lower Deschutes River (Thurston County) closed to all fishing
items.locations: Deschutes River in Thurston County from the mouth (a line projected across the river 400 feet downstream of the lower Tumwater Falls fish ladder) to the Old Highway 99 (Capital Boulevard Southeast) Bridge.
items.action: Closes all fishing.

items.title: Lake Washington reopens for salmon fishing
items.locations: Lake Washington (King County) north of Highway 520 Bridge and east of Montlake Bridge, including the portion of the Sammamish River near Kenmore from 68th Avenue Northeast downstream.
items.action: Returns Lake Washington to permanent rules listed in the Washington Sport Fishing Rules , reopening salmon fishing.

items.title: Tucannon River hatchery steelhead fishing update
items.locations: Tucannon River from the mouth to the Tucannon Hatchery Road bridge.
items.action: Reduces hatchery steelhead daily limit.

items.title: Snake River hatchery steelhead fishing update
items.action: Reduces hatchery steelhead daily limits.

items.title: Snake River fall Chinook fishery update
items.action: Closes retention of wild (unmarked) adult Chinook in Snake River beginning Sept. 18.

items.title: Yakima River fall salmon fishery to open
items.locations: Yakima River from the Highway 240 bridge in Richland (river mile 2.1) to the Grant Avenue Bridge in Prosser (river mile 47.0).
items.action: Opens the lower Yakima River salmon retention.

items.title: Lower Columbia River salmon and steelhead fishery update
items.action: Allows retention of one additional adult hatchery coho as part of the daily limit from the Buoy 10 line upstream to the west end of Puget Island.

items.title: Lower Naselle River gear restriction update
items.locations: Naselle River, from the confluence of the South Fork upstream to the Highway 4 bridge.
items.action: Rescinds requirement for bait or lure to be suspended below a float, except when trolling from a floating device, beginning Oct. 15.

items.title: Upper Green (Duwamish) River closed to fishing from Sept. 16–Oct. 31
items.locations: Green (Duwamish) River, from Auburn Black Diamond Road Bridge to the Tacoma Municipal Boundary Marker.
items.action: Closes all fishing.

items.title: Green (Duwamish) River Chinook retention closed
items.locations: Green (Duwamish) River from Tukwila International Boulevard/Old Highway 99 to the South 212 th Street Bridge.
items.action: Closes Chinook salmon retention.

items.title: Fall Chinook harvest to open in the Snake River
items.action: Opens Chinook salmon retention in areas of the Snake River.

items.title: WDFW classifies invasive golden mussels as prohibited statewide
